contract.overview_summary: Weekly Overview stays a summary; new summary rows derived from Posts rows carry the technical key in column U (_row_key). Legacy overview rows are retained untouched. Platforms without an overview column (X, Google Business Profile, unfamiliar labels) appear only in the Posts table — no generic-platform fallback into TikTok or any named column.
contract.idempotency_contract: Readback of Posts!A2:N (and Weekly Overview!A2:U) before any write; existing row_key => values.update on exactly that row; missing => one append. Durable claim/ledger lives in the ONB/CC caller; the webhook stays stateless-safe via readback (F15).
